description: Presidential Secretariat - Appointment of His Excellency Maithripala Sirisena as the President of Sri Lanka w.e.f. 09.01.2015. Appointment of Honourable Ranil Wickramasinghe as the Prime Minister of Sri Lanka w.e.f. 09.01.2015. Appointment of Mr. E. M. S. B. Ekanayake as the Secretary to the Prime Minister w.e.f. 10.01.2015
categorisation: This gazette notification names President Maithripala Sirisena and provides detailed portfolio assignments for the Minister of Defence, including specific duties & functions, departments/institutions under their purview, and laws to be implemented. It contains both the "who" (the President making the assignment) and detailed "what" (comprehensive portfolio responsibilities), making it a Hybrid gazette.
